title: Astrid and the Debt
author: Freya Lockridge
blurb: Mirabel Okafor, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
